title: ReTerm: Recovery Training for Self-Improving Terminal Agents
title_zh: ReTerm：面向自我改进型终端智能体的恢复训练

paragraphs.en: ReTerm 是一种通过学习从自身失败任务中恢复来实现自我改进的终端智能体。 Terminal agents have shown strong abilities in complex coding tasks. However, they often struggle to recover from errors during long-running execution (e.g., command errors, faulty implementations), eventually leading to task failures. To this end, we present ReTerm, a self-improving terminal agent trained by learning how to recover from its own failed terminal tasks. To support its training, we construct a customized data pipeline and produce ReTerm-10K, a high-quality dataset that provides effective recovery demonstrations for SFT cold start. Furthermore, we propose ReTerm-GRPO, an online RL algorithm that forks from the agent's own failure states to generate multiple independent self-recovery attempts. By learning from whether these attempts successfully complete the task, the agent self-improves through its own recovery experience. Built on Qwen3.5-9B, our ReTerm-9B achieves 34.8% Pass@1 on Terminal-Bench 2.0, improving over the base model by 14.6 points. Further analysis shows that our method achieves consistently higher recovery rates across diverse error categories compared with standard GRPO training. All code, data and model are released at https://github.com/twothsnd/ReTerm.
paragraphs.zh: ReTerm 是一种通过从自身失败任务中恢复来实现自我改进的终端智能体。终端智能体在复杂的编码任务中展现了强大的能力。 然而，它们在长时间运行过程中常常难以从错误中恢复（例如命令错误或实现错误），最终导致任务失败。 为此，我们提出了 ReTerm，一种通过学习如何从自身失败的终端任务中恢复而训练出来的自我改进型终端智能体。 为支持其训练，我们构建了一条定制化的数据管道，并创建了 ReTerm-10K——一个高质量的数据集，为 SFT 冷启动提供了有效的恢复演示。 此外，我们提出了 ReTerm-GRPO，一种在线强化学习算法，它从智能体自身的失败状态分叉，以生成多个独立的自我恢复尝试。 通过从这些尝试是否成功完成任务中学习，该智能体能够借助自身的恢复经验实现自我改进。 基于 Qwen3.5-9B 构建的 ReTerm-9B 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上实现了 34.8% 的 Pass@1，比基础模型提升了 14.6 个百分点。 进一步分析表明，与标准的 GRPO 训练相比，我们的方法在不同错误类别中均能实现更高且更稳定的恢复率。 所有代码、数据和模型均已发布在 https://github.com/twothsnd/ReTerm。
